entries.title: The Wolf Among Us
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with all five episodes installed

primary.why: The Wolf Among Us is a five-episode Telltale adventure, and the PC release is the cleanest capture route for the complete season. A remaster has been announced for later 2026, but this entry should preserve the currently available original-season route until the remaster is actually released and evaluated.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam/GOG. Record storefront/build, episode availability, save/import state, graphics settings, subtitles, choice state, and whether the announced remaster was available at play time.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a specific platform route.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route for the same episodic season.
